notes: Resolved software revisions for the MOSS runtime. Baseline = what the current image actually builds (start from the existing ComfyUI pin to isolate runtime effects).

The candidate cu130+ wheel set is resolved and frozen during the Phase 2 candidate build (TORCH_SPEC/TORCH_INDEX build args in runpod/Dockerfile.moss); until then its fields are explicitly unresolved placeholders and must never be read as installed versions.

After a candidate image is built, run `python runtime_check.py --json` inside it and paste the result into candidate_runtime.observed so the lock records what was actually measured, not what the Dockerfile requested.

comfyui.note: MOSS-Image support present (merged >= e087d8f6). Pin kept for the first comparison rounds; a separately pinned v0.43.0 candidate is compared only after this baseline is sound.

rgthree.note: Previously a floating 'main' clone; pinned by this lock.

comfy_kitchen.pin: VERIFY: record exact version from pip freeze during the candidate build

torch.cuda_build: VERIFY: capture with runtime_check inside the deployed container; research hypothesis says the base image carries cu126 which disables the comfy-kitchen CUDA backend

comfyui_v043_candidate.policy: Tested as a separate pinned candidate AFTER the baseline comparison; never silently upgraded in place.

comfyui_spectrum_moss.license: VERIFY: record the repo license file in the dependency manifest at install time

candidate_runtime_cu130.torch: UNRESOLVED: pin exact cu130+ wheel set (torch/torchvision/torchaudio) compatible with the pinned ComfyUI at candidate-build time
candidate_runtime_cu130.install_policy: Matched torchvision/torchaudio versions; dependency consistency proven by `pip check`, import checks and a real GPU execution before the profile is served.

observed.purpose: Filled by runtime_check.py --json inside the deployed/candidate container
